The main takeaway from our work is that

the parasites isolated from Ranong, the upper southern area, contained the pfmdr184F allele, which has been associated with resistance to mefloquine and lumefantrine, two major anti-malarial agents used in the treatment of P. falciparium in Thailand.
the pfmdr 184F allele is a potential marker of in vitro CQ resistance and the pfmd 1 86T allele is a potential CQ resistance marker in P. falariparum isolates in the upper southern part.
